title: Evidence Handover Bundle
description: Packages a case-file binder manifest plus its caller-pasted referenced receipts into one client-side zip: a self-contained offline verify.html (zero network calls at verify time), the raw JSON receipts, and a plain-English README explaining what verified does and does not mean. Optionally attaches a pre-captured DNSSEC chain (dig +dnssec output the caller ran externally) as a corroboration item; this tool never queries DNS itself and never validates the chain. Built for handing an examiner a bundle they can open on an air-gapped machine.

receipts.description: Optional list of receipt JSON objects the caller has in hand, matched to binder entries by digest

dnssec_chain_capture.description: Optional. A DNSSEC chain the caller captured externally (dig +dnssec), pasted in raw. Not fetched or validated by this tool.

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_evidence_handover_bundle
mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds an offline zip bundle (self-contained verify.html, binder + receipt JSON files, README) from a case-file binder manifest and the receipts it references. The worker never sees receipt contents.

receipts.description: Optional list of receipt JSON objects the caller has in hand, matched to binder entries by digest

dnssec_chain_capture.description: Optional pre-captured DNSSEC chain (queried_name, resolver, captured_at, raw_chain_text) to include as corroboration. Never fetched or validated by this tool; verification is deferred to standard tooling such as delv.
